A.evidence: No persisted counts, totals, flags, caches, or duplicated values requiring synchronization are present.

B.evidence: All I/O and authentication checks are confined to controllers or Livewire component methods without mixing domain decisions with side‑effects.

C.evidence: Routing and Blade templates contain no hidden policy logic; the route correctly points to App\Livewire\Home.

D.evidence: No hidden ordering or readiness flags; component methods have explicit dependencies.

E.evidence: No unused abstractions or speculative code; all classes and methods serve a clear purpose.

F.evidence: All functions are well under 40 lines, files under 400 lines, and nesting is shallow.

G.evidence: No caching layers or derived indexes are present that could leak state.
